name: windows driver tests

# Exercises the Windows kernel driver analysis against real compiler output and
# real signed drivers, neither of which the unit tests or the LOLDrivers harness
# can reach: the unit tests use hand-written assembly, and the LOLDrivers dataset
# publishes import lists rather than binaries.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'blint/lib/driver_ioctl.py'
      - 'blint/lib/binary_reviews.py'
      - 'blint/data/annotations/review_drivers_win.yml'
      - 'contrib/win-driver-fixture/**'
      - '.github/workflows/drivertests.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
permissions: {}

jobs:
  build-fixture:
    # Builds the driver-shaped fixture whose control codes are known ahead of
    # time. MSVC is preinstalled on the runner; no WDK is needed.
    name: build driver fixture
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      # build.cmd resolves the MSVC environment itself through vswhere. The
      # runner image moves between Visual Studio versions - windows-latest now
      # carries VS 2026, whose install path is ...\18\Enterprise rather than
      # ...\2022\Enterprise - so the toolset must be located, not assumed.
      - name: Build fixture
        shell: cmd
        run: |
          mkdir out
          call contrib\win-driver-fixture\build.cmd %CD%\out\blint_test_driver.sys
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a  # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: blint-test-driver
          path: out/blint_test_driver.sys
          if-no-files-found: error

  verify-recovery:
    # The analysis runs on Linux because nyxstone, and therefore disassembly, is
    # only installed there (the Windows job in bintests.yml uses
    # --without=extended).
    name: verify IOCTL recovery
    needs: build-fixture
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c  # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: blint-test-driver
          path: out
      - name: Linux packages
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y zlib1g-dev libzstd-dev llvm-18 llvm-18-dev
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97  # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'
      - name: Install blint
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install poetry
          poetry install --all-groups --all-extras
        env:
          NYXSTONE_LLVM_PREFIX: /usr/lib/llvm-18
      - name: Verify recovery against ground truth
        run: |
          poetry run python contrib/win-driver-fixture/verify_recovery.py \
            out/blint_test_driver.sys | tee recovery.txt
      - name: Summarise
        if: always()
        run: |
          {
            echo '### Driver IOCTL recovery'
            echo '```'
            cat recovery.txt
            echo '```'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  inbox-driver-precision:
    # A false-positive sweep over the signed Microsoft drivers already present on
    # th

        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install '.[dev]'
      - name: Run tests
        env:
          SPEAKEASY_ENABLE_GDB_TESTS: "1"
        run: pytest tests/
